1.title: Controller for enabling and disabling a chiller
1.prompt: Could you please generate a Modelica control block for enabling and disabling a chiller? The inputs are chilled water supply temperature TChi_CHWST, set temperature for chilled water leaving chiller TChiSet. The output is a Boolean signal y (1: Enable, 0: Disable). The control sequences are described as follows: • The chiller is enabled when TChi_CHWST > TChiSet + TDeaBan. TDeaBan is dead band to prevent short cycling. • The chiller is disabled when TChi_CHWST ≤ TChiSet.

2.title: Controller for chilled water minimum flow bypass valve
2.prompt: Could you please generate a Modelica block for the chilled water minimum flow bypass valve controller for primary-only plants with a minimum flow bypass valve, according to ASHRAE Guideline 36 section 5.20.8? The inputs are the measured chilled water flow rate through chillers VChiWat_flow, minimum chilled water flow setpoint VChiWatSet_flow, and a Boolean input uChiWatPum (maximum status feedback of all the chilled water pumps: true means at least one pump is proven on). The output is chilled water minimum flow bypass valve position yValPos. The control sequences are described as follows: • When any chilled water pump is proven on (uChiWatPum = true), the bypass valve PID loop shall be enabled. The valve shall be opened 100% otherwise. When enabled, the bypass valve loop shall be biased to start with the valve 100% open.

3.title: Cooling tower fan speed control block
3.prompt: Could you please generate a Modelica control block for the cooling tower speed control? The inputs are (1) the real inputs of condenser water supply temperature (CWST) setpoint TCWSupSet and measurement TCWSup; (2) chilled water supply temperature (CHWST) setpoint TCHWSupSet and measurement TCHWSup; (3) Integer input of the cooling mode cooMod (Free Cooling – 0, Partially Mechanical Cooling – 1, Fully Mechanical Cooling - 2). The output y is the speed signal for cooling tower fans. The control sequences are described as follows: • When the system is in Fully Mechanical Cooling (FMC) mode, the cooling tower fan speed is controlled to maintain the condenser water supply temperature (CWST) at or around the setpoint. • When the system is in Partially Mechanical Cooling (PMC) mode, the cooling tower fan speed is set as 100% to make condenser water as cold as possible and maximize the waterside economizer output. • When the system is in Free Cooling (FC) mode, the cooling tower fan speed is controlled to maintain the chilled water supply temperature (CHWST) at or around its setpoint.

4.title: Output chilled water reset request and chiller plant request based on Section 5.16.16.1 and 5.16.16.2 of Guideline 36
4.prompt: Could you please generate a Modelica control block for outputting the chilled water reset request and chiller plant request based on Section 5.16.16 of Guideline 36? The inputs are real inputs of supply air temperature TAirSup and its setpoint TAirSupSet, and chilled water valve position uCooCoi. The outputs are the integer chilled water reset request yChiWatResReq and chiller plant request yChiPlaReq. For chilled water reset request yChiWatResReq, the control sequences are described as follows: • If the supply air temperature TAirSup exceeds the supply air temperature set point TAirSupSet by 3 °C (5 °F) for 2 minutes, send 3 requests. • If the supply air temperature TAirSup exceeds the supply air temperature set point TAirSupSet by 2 °C (3 °F) for 2 minutes, send 2 requests. • Else if the chilled water valve position uCooCoiSet is greater than 95%, send 1 request until the uCooCoiSet is less than 85%. • Else if the chilled water valve position uCooCoiSet is less than 95%, send 0 request. For chiller plant request yChiPlaReq, the control sequences are described as follows: • If the chilled water valve position uCooCoiSet is greater than 95%, send 1 request until the uCooCoiSet is less than 10%. • Else if the chilled water valve position uCooCoiSet is less than 95%, send 0 request.

5.title: Relief damper control for AHUs using actuated dampers without fan
5.prompt: Could you please generate a Modelica control block for relief damper control for AHUs using actuated dampers without fan based on the Section 5.16.8 of ASHRAE Guideline G36? The inputs are real input of building static pressure difference dpBui, and Boolean input signal u1SupFan. The output signal is relief damper commanded position yRelDam. The control sequences are described as follows: • Relief dampers shall be enabled when the associated supply fan is proven on (u1SupFan = true), and disabled otherwise. • When enabled, use a P-only control loop to modulate relief dampers to maintain building static pressure dpBui at its setpoint, which is by default 12 Pa (0.05 inchWC). • Close damper when disabled.
